title: Orlando Brown Jr.: I feel Bengals have the best pass protection unit in the NFL

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Orlando Brown Jr.: I feel Bengals have the best pass protection unit in the NFL
sources.description: Defensive upgrades have been the main focus of the Bengals offseason, but they'll need to remain a potent offensive team as well if they are going to make it back to the playoffs for the first time since 2022.
